name: MagicalDownloader
description:
MagicalDownloader Chinese name: Wonderful Download

This extension can help users list their current media resources and assist them in downloading.
Includes m3u8 parser and a simple dash parser.

This project is based on cat claws, achieving a more modern UI and interaction. Welcome to experience it

Open source repository: https://github.com/9292922/MagicalDownloader
Original author's open-source repository: https://github.com/xifangczy/cat-catch

To submit bugs, please go to GitHub or search for other submission methods in the documentation. Please provide as detailed the operation steps as possible, including the website address. If authorization login is required, please send it to me via email, otherwise we will not be able to assist you.
Document Description: https://cat-catch.bmmmd.com/

The extension is not responsible for the content downloaded by users, so please check the copyright and permissions of the content before downloading.
